# join_amplicon_summaries.R

## join_amplicon_summaries()

```{r}
join_amplicon_summaries(
  source_dir = "data",
  file_name = "reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_",
  n_amplicons = 9,
  minimum_count_thresholds = c(2, 5, 10, 20),
  HOM_cutoff = 70,
  HET_low_cutoff = 30, 
  HET_high_cutoff = 70,
  output_dir = "data"
)
```
